issue: ALT of 157.5 U/L (4.5x ULN) at Week 8 is isolated between normal values, and no matching adverse event is recorded.
query_text: At the Week 8 visit (2012-10-27) the ALT result was 157.5 U/L (normal range 6–35 U/L, 4.5x ULN). ALT was 13 U/L at Week 6 (2012-10-13) and 12 U/L at Week 12 (2012-11-27). AST (26 U/L) and bilirubin (10.26 umol/L) were normal on the same date. No adverse event for a raised liver enzyme is recorded. Please confirm that the Week 8 ALT value and units were entered correctly. If the value is correct, please say whether the investigator considers it clinically significant and, if so, record an adverse event or explain why none was reported. Please also say whether any repeat test was done.

issue: Disposition reason is ADVERSE EVENT, but no adverse event has an action taken with study drug recorded, so it is unclear which event led to discontinuation.
query_text: The Disposition form gives the reason for discontinuation as "ADVERSE EVENT" (Week 16, 2012-12-24), and the last dose was 2012-12-04. On the Adverse Events form, the "action taken" field is blank for all recorded events (application site irritation from 2012-09-13, chills from 2012-10-09). Please tell us which adverse event led to discontinuation and update the action taken with study drug on that record. Please also confirm the discontinuation date relative to the last dose date of 2012-12-04.

issue: Several AE records have an end date but outcome NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED, and the records for the same event have identical dates but different severities and outcomes.
query_text: Four records of application site irritation share the same start date (2012-09-13) and end date (2013-01-02). Their severities differ (mild, moderate, severe, mild). Three have the outcome "NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED" (AE 1, 2, 3) and one has "RECOVERED/RESOLVED" (AE 6). In the same way, two records of chills (start 2012-10-09, end 2012-10-15) have the outcomes "NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED" (AE 4) and "RECOVERED/RESOLVED" (AE 5). An event with an end date would normally not be "not recovered". Please check these records. If severity changed over time, please give each episode its own start and end dates and a matching outcome. Please also remove any duplicate entries.
